abstract: Install, serve, tune, scale out, update and troubleshoot vLLM, the OpenAI-compatible LLM inference server. Covers pip/uv, Docker, NVIDIA NGC, ROCm and CPU installs; vllm serve flags and config files; tool-call and reasoning parsers, structured outputs, LoRA, multimodal and embeddings; FP8 and NVFP4 formats; tensor, pipeline, expert and data parallelism with Ray or multiprocessing multi-node; EAGLE-3; vllm bench, Prometheus metrics and Kubernetes. Includes combos for two DGX Sparks, AMD ROCm, RTX Blackwell, llm-compressor FP8 and EAGLE-3, plus compose, systemd and Kubernetes templates. Verified against vLLM v0.31.0.
